browserFinal.report:
# R232 preview QA — final

**PASS** on unpublished Shopify theme **214040805767** (“LuxeStyle – Kaufhinweis 15.11.2026”). Runtime DOM reports the exact theme ID and role `unpublished`; theme assets load from `/cdn/shop/t/30/`. The preview parameter is stripped during redirects, but the rendered theme ID remains correct.

At 390×844 and 1440×900, the section has all 16 full image cards in the baseline order, plus the separate “Alle Kategorien entdecken” link. All 16 hrefs match baseline, including Kinder und Baby → `/collections/sub-baby-kids` and Schmuck → `/collections/schmuck`.

- Mobile: 2 columns, 173×173 px cards, 14 px corners.
- Desktop: 4 columns, 316×237 px cards, 16 px corners.
- All images loaded with responsive sources; `object-fit: cover`. New Kids and Schmuck art loaded at 175×218 px mobile and 332×415 px desktop.
- Labels and arrows compute to white. No label overflow, horizontal page overflow, or CSS failures. The visual screenshots show no clipping or arrow contrast issue. Some older background images contain small embedded words, but the overlaid category labels remain legible.

Screenshots: `mobile-lx-worlds-section.png`, `desktop-lx-worlds-section.png`. Fixed/sticky header and cookie overlays were hidden using temporary DOM visibility styling for these section captures; no consent choice was made. No links were clicked.

Two page.goto calls were made. Shopify generated six top-level navigation requests across the two loads because each preview request redirected through `luxestyle.ch` and removed the preview query. Non-GET, analytics/telemetry, product/API, cart, checkout, and account requests were blocked. The prior before-correction capture remains in `../browser-preview/`; it is not used for final image validation.
limits: German homepage section at 390x844 and 1440x900; no full-store or all-language acceptance.
Screenshot-only masking of fixed/sticky header and cookie layers; no click or consent action.

Two first baseline loads had an over-broad QA image guard and were corrected. Before-correction preview retained, then two final page.goto calls after confirmed new index source. One final-runner ReferenceError failed before page.goto; fixed locally.
Native screenshot renderer has known malformed header/desktop output; normal Chromium independently checked.
Other 14 existing category backgrounds retained, including some embedded old banner words; not 16 new or all text-free images.
